note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Medford-Park Falls RD) on the northwest shore of 170-acre Sailor Lake, with direct access to the Flambeau ATV Trail. Two wooded loops; sites 5 and 6 look through the trees to the lake, but no site is near the water, and 23-25 are walk-to tent sites in clearings by the shore. Sites 1-12, 24 and 25 take reservations, the rest are first-come. The boat landing is at the picnic area half a mile south on FR 139. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov record/catalog read: 25 sites (3 walk-to tent, 1 double), up to 45+ ft with per-site limits, pull-throughs 8/12/19/21, no hookups or dump, vault toilets + water, $15 ($30 double), May 1 - Oct 31; sites 1-12/24/25 reservable in summer with a 4-day cutoff, rest FCFS. LAKEVIEW KEPT (FS: 'some sites have a view of the water, none ... near the water'; site 5/6 photos show the lake through trees). Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview KEPT. The FS page says 'While some sites have a view of the water, none of the sites are near the water.' On Esri imagery with the rec.gov site points, the nearest RV sites (5 at 45.8423,-90.2756; 17 at 45.8411,-90.2758) are ~30-55 m from the east shore under continuous canopy; the official rec.gov photos of sites 5 and 6 show the lake through the trees (a filtered view). The open shore clearings belong to walk-to tent sites 23-25 (rec.gov's 'some are situated on the waterfront' is those). All sites are sold by the night.

OHV: rec.gov calls it 'a favorite among off-road enthusiasts, offering direct access to the 70-mile Flambeau Trail System' (ATVs, off-road motorcycles, horses); a site-17 photo shows a side-by-side. It is a general FS lake campground with an OHV side, not a staging area - flag only, for the reviewer.

HORSE?: the FS length table ends 'Corrals: RV up to 35 Feet' with no further explanation; no horse sites or corrals are named in the rec.gov catalog or the site list. Flag only - the reviewer may want to know whether horse corrals sit among the general loops (the Flambeau Trail allows horseback riding).

ALERT: Emergency Closure Order 09-13-04-26-04 (Oct 2, 2026 - Sep 1, 2027) closes only trail 326A between FR 119 and FR 1417 in the Medford-Park Falls district - not the campground. The FS page currently shows 'Site Closed ... the campground is closed for the season' (ordinary seasonal close).
